_metric_races: 2026-09-29 (Claude): a suggestion with "_metric" is judged by the thing it fixes (scripts/loop/metrics.py): a skill's success rate ("ok:explore") or deaths per game minute ("deaths"), counted over every paired task, both sides. Crowned at z >= metric_z once each side has metric_min tries, while its whole-game pairs stay above metric_safety_t; dropped at z <= 0 or when the game score says it hurts. Whole-game races alone crowned nothing in gens 50-58 (paired sd 3-4.7). 2026-10-04 (Claude, after g164): judged world by world (paired t over worlds where both sides had tries, metric_min_worlds), not pooled tries; an idea that logs its exposure (an evolved skill, or "_exposure") must have acted in exposure_min_games games to win, and one that never acted leaves as inconclusive, not as a loss.
